services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: The Strong offers a wide range of educational programs for students amid dynamic, hands-on exhibits and world-renowned collections. Field trips can be adapted to meet the needs of teachers or utilized by homeschoolers. See Group Reservation FAQs to learn more. The Strong Museum is an ideal destination for school groups to explore and learn on their own. Self-guided field trips provide schools and other groups the opportunity to explore the museum independently. Self-guided field trips are only available Monday-Friday during the school year (September to June). Self-guided field trips cost $14 per student. services.desc: Looking for a memorable birthday party or a private space for a special celebration? The Strong National Museum of Play offers unique party spaces and playful exhibit surroundings perfect for birthdays, engagements, graduations, anniversaries, family reunions, baby showers, and more. Celebrate life’s milestones in a setting your guests will love. If you need to cancel, a 50% refund will be issued. Parties may also be rescheduled to another available date. services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: The Strong National Museum of Play’s It’s Alive summer camp invites kids to discover the wonders of the natural world through play! Campers will explore the vibrant Dancing Wings Butterfly Garden, observe aquatic life up close at the Rainbow Reef aquarium, and meet real animals-such as tortoises, geckos, and snakes.
